subject: This ain't burnout.
author: kevlar0
body:
Ive never heard such claptrap, Absolutely pointless addition to the game and they have the cheek to charge for it, if C/G don't pull there finger out soon and get the real problems sorted (we all know what they are) a lot of true burners who have stuck with it over the last year are gonna say "kcuf it" they aint sorting the fundamental problems out that have been there from the start and seem content in announcing wishy washy shite.

If it carries on like this i'll be trading it for MCLA.

He's not the messiah, he's a very naughty boy.

subject: Virus got, and Burnout Toy Cars as DLC
author: SUFFUR
body:
Got the trojan, I hope?

And the next pack for Paradsie is 9 cars, taken down in scale, not sure what size, proabably 1:35 scale, but we will have to see, I did make a comment, one time or another for this a while ago, to help me avoid traffic, lol. But this will be a premium pack, so buy or don't? I will, because I was a fan of Mirco-Machine games, and Re-Volt, the first XBox Live game if I can remember that far back?

Plus I assume the new Island pack will reflect more micro game play, but just going around Paradise as it is will be fun, race track will be longer, flat spins and barrel rolls, will be huge'er (not a word kids, and ladies maybe, lol).

Will we be allowed to drive under traffic, don't know? But Paradise will get bigger from the Toy Car point of view?

And will the Roadster me Mini Me'ed? Hope so!

How will they Handle, what speeds will they go, we will have to wait and see?

But I am looking forward to them, as well as the Legendary Car pack, Party Pack as I said will do at Burnoutaholics HQ, and That was not cleared up, can you sign on, on someones 360 who has the pack, and play with them, and still get the achievements? A question for Criterion I think, anyone?

Right I'm done, see ya all laters, and await the news of the 2 extra pack not mentioned before, race track pack, fingers crossed, lol, or stunt run pack, to construct your own stunt run park, though I think that is the Island!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
